defects.title: Alembic migrations fail on every startup and the failure is silent: the initial migration is empty, the schema is created by `create_all`, `alembic_version` never exists
No application or uvicorn logs reach the console after startup: `fileConfig()` in `alembic/env.py` disables the existing loggers
`GET /health` returns `200` with `"status": "ok"` when the database is down
Log records are incomplete: `ip` and `duration_ms` are never filled, `method` / `status_code` are missing for auth events, two message formats
Security events are not logged: failed authentication (invalid / forged token) and rate limit violations (429) leave no record
`500` responses carry no CORS headers — the browser shows a CORS error instead of the server error
Allowed CORS origins are hardcoded in `main.py` (`http://localhost:3000`)
Setup docs: `POSTGRES_USER` / `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` / `POSTGRES_DB` required by `docker-compose.yml` are missing from the README and `.env.example`
Swagger: items endpoints have no descriptions, no error codes (401/403/404) and no response schemas

questions.question: The `logs` table grows without limit (no retention or cleanup). What is the retention policy?
